t: The Hillbrush Nail Brush is a robust cleaning tool designed for effective hand and nail cleaning. Its durable wooden block and dual-sided design make it ideal for tradespeople and DIY enthusiasts tackling tough dirt, grease and grime after site work, gardening, or general manual tasks. Featuring tough white nylon bristles that soften in water, this 97mm brush provides thorough cleaning performance while remaining comfortable on the skin. It is a practical choice for maintaining hygiene in demanding work environments.
